tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search IP Computers's Hebrew guides, product and service pages (SentinelOne EDR, ransomware, backup, RMM, VPS, firewall monitoring). Returns matching pages with title, URL, summary and a relevance score.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List every product and service sold on IP Computers with its id, vendor, category, monthly price in ILS before VAT, billing unit (per endpoint, user, server or month) and page URL. Items with quote_only=true are priced by quote. Shows an interactive catalog where the host supports MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product or service by id: description, highlights, price, billing unit, page and Markdown URLs, and the direct purchase URL when it is sold online.

tools.name: build_quote
tools.description: Price a basket of products for a monthly subscription: line totals, subtotal, VAT and total in ILS. Returns online_checkout_url when the basket can be bought online (one SentinelOne plan plus supported add-ons), otherwise a quote request URL. Does not buy anything. tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote or contact request to IP Computers' sales team, who reply by phone or email on business days. Call only after the person explicitly agreed to share their name, email and phone. Sends one email to the sales team; it does not create an order or charge anything.

tools.name: get_trial_info
tools.description: Describe the free SentinelOne trial (2 licenses for 14 days, no card required) and return the sign-up URL. The person completes the sign-up and SMS verification themselves.

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Return IP Computers's sales phone, email, WhatsApp link, business hours and contact page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, list_products, get_product, get_trial_info, get_contact_info · Private data: request_quote, get_contact_info · Public sink: request_quote, get_trial_info, get_contact_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, list_products, get_product, get_trial_info, get_contact_info · Private data: request_quote, get_contact_info · Public sink: request_quote, get_trial_info, get_contact_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
